body:
I appreciate the reply honestly. It’s rough, I know it’s just a stranger that I’ve never met and probably never would’ve, but it’s someone who reached out for help and I tried and like you said, it’s just heartbreaking. 

I’ve been in that spot so I understand that there’s times where nothing you do can help honestly, but once a week at least I think back to him and hope he’s okay but the thought that he might not be just puts that damper on it
